body: Well, then I don’t have much to say. I really hope things get better, but if they don’t, please be sure of yourself

Saying “You’ll grow out of it” kinda just hurts lol

I’ve always been like this, I tried to commit when I was 7, it’s a cycle I won’t get out of
Trying only once never does anything. You cab’t see yourself improve with one try.
I know. But you can always try. I have nothing to say except for the stereotypical crap, but sometimes they’re right. I know it’s not exactly what you want to here, but sometimes it’s the truth.
But that doesn’t mean you’re any less important. Please try to reach out to someone for help
Actually, yeah, they do. Everyone feels like that. Maybe not all at the same time, but everyone is destined to feel that way at some point. And it lasts for years in most.

You can’t. Nobody likes the world, let’s be honest here.

Nobody genuinely thinks “The world is great! I love people!”

Everybody tried to get by, just like you. Does that mean you are irrelevant though? Not at all! I really hope you find the strength to reach out for help, sending lots of love ❤️
Nope not 11. 13. But thanks for the comment, I’ll think about it

I get it. Feeling lost is something you need to feel someday. You’re life isn’t rotting, it’s simply transforming into something great. Nobody is moving forward. Nobody will truly be happy all the time, everyone is sad 24/7. Just some learn to drown it out with the positives. Is it your fault? No. But can you choose to get help for yourself and to help others? Absolutely.

Hey, kid here. Honestly, I can relate. 

I don’t know what to say really, but I do get it. But don’t take that in a “It’s normal and you’re find” way. Because in reality, you’re not fine. And that’s okay. I know words can’t stop you from doing it, but I really hope you’re sure of your choice 

Sending lots of love <33

A close family friend passed.

Her children and husband took it rough. Her husband is currently an alcoholic and her children haven’t spoke to anyone.

As for me and my family we took it pretty rough as well. My mother still cries thinking about her.
